    # gryonixnexus: vaultwarden
    @gryonixnexus_open path /api/* /identity/* /notifications/* /icons/* /attachments/* /.well-known/* /alive /app-id.json
    handle @gryonixnexus_open {

        reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8082
    }
}
